findings.governingReading: 削ぎ落とされた体力も回復している achieved restored reserves, no bodily abnormality in self-assessment.
findings.explanation: Recovered physical reserves become still recovering.

findings.evidenceJa: 明日の昼には意識を取り戻すだろう
findings.governingReading: 明日の昼には gives predicted by tomorrow midday if all goes well.

findings.highlight: vampiric species laid to rest on that very soil.
findings.evidenceJa: 吸血種が寝床にしていた
findings.governingReading: 寝床にしていた means used land as bed/lair;曰くつき associated sinister history.
findings.explanation: Vampiric being’s sleeping place becomes death/resting place.

findings.highlight: It is said that vampiric species laid to rest on that very soil.
findings.evidenceJa: 吸血種が寝床にしていた
findings.governingReading: It-is-said-that clause needs were-laid-to-rest or lay/rested for intransitive sleep.
findings.explanation: Laid-to-rest lacks passive auxiliary or transitive object.

findings.highlight: then he has all of his pawns in hand.
findings.evidenceJa: 向かう先には全ての駒が揃っていると見るべきだ。
findings.governingReading: Given Zouken's presumed interest in Illya, Shirou should expect all the pieces to be assembled at his destination.
findings.explanation: Shirou's expectation that all the pieces will be at his destination becomes a statement that Zouken has his pawns in hand. This shifts the tactical emphasis from gathering to possession without proving total control over anyone.

findings.highlight: She said that they needed to go to her castle to get her dress.
findings.evidenceJa: 正装がほしかったら城に来いって言っていた。
findings.governingReading: 正装がほしかったら城に来い reports Illya’s conditional invitation/order concerning needed attire.
findings.explanation: Come if you want formal attire becomes they need to fetch her dress.

findings.highlight: You should be thanking me right now
findings.evidenceJa: 私程度でも有り難いはず
findings.governingReading: 私程度でも modestly qualifies worth of his help in absence Rin.
findings.explanation: Even someone of my level would help becomes simply you should thank me.
